description: Open-source Kubernetes FinOps operator: cost per namespace, team, GPU and LLM token, schedules that scale idle environments to zero, budgets, chargeback and right-sizing with a rollback guard.
rules: Install with Helm: helm upgrade --install costdeck-operator oci://ghcr.io/migalsp/costdeck/charts/costdeck-operator --namespace costdeck --create-namespace
Settings live in the CostDeckConfig named default in the operator namespace; credentials go to Secrets referenced by *SecretRef fields, never into the custom resource.
A namespace without a schedule is always on; a ScalingGroup takes several namespaces and cloud resources, a ScalingConfig one namespace.
Right-sizing only advises until an admin allows applying it; applied changes are watched and put back if pods fail.
The MCP server is at https://<host>/mcp with an API token; a viewer token gives read-only tools.
